title: Major update of Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27) is available for existing customers
summary: The BC27 (2025 release wave 2) major update is now available to existing customers, with dates that vary by country and region. Admins can move the scheduled date within the update period through the Business Central Admin Center, and the last day to apply it is February 28, 2026. The author's test update from 26.5 to 27.0 shows up in the environment operation log and ends with a confirmation email.
key_points: BC27 major update is generally available with scheduled rollout dates varying by region
Customers can reschedule update dates within the update period using the Business Central Admin Center
Last day to apply the update is February 28, 2026; the example notice schedules SandboxNA260 for November 5, 2025
Environment operation logs track update progress and completion with notification emails confirming successful upgrades

quotes.text: The major update of Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27) is available for existing customers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms the general availability of BC27 and its applicability to existing customer environments

quotes.text: You can reschedule this update for any date within the update period or choose a different version to update your environment to next.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the flexible update management capability that gives customers control over when to apply the BC27 upgrade

quotes.text: The update must be scheduled to run before Mar 01, 2026 09:00 AM (UTC+09:00).
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the mandatory deadline for applying the BC27 update to ensure environments remain supported
